name: gemma4-dev
description: Claude Code plugins for Google Cloud TPU DevOps: one management skill and one MCP server per Gemma 4 serving rig (JAX, PyTorch/torch_xla). Both are named after the rig directory — skill <rig>-management, tools prefixed mcp__<rig>__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: TPU DevOps for the pure-JAX Gemma 4 rig: provisioning, queued resources, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-jax-v5e1-2b MCP server. Serves google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-w4a16-ct on v5e-1 with no Docker and no HF token.

plugins.name: tpu-pytorch-v5e1-12b
plugins.description: TPU DevOps for the PyTorch/torch_xla Gemma 4 12B rig: provisioning, queued resources, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-pytorch-v5e1-12b MCP server. Static-shape decode server on v5e-1.

plugins.name: tpu-pytorch-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: TPU DevOps for the PyTorch/torch_xla Gemma 4 2B rig: provisioning, queued resources, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-pytorch-v5e1-2b MCP server. Static-shape decode server on v5e-1.
